mutate(., Detection_qPCR= if_else(avg_Detection_qPCR>0,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(time_chunk = case_when(Sample_date < '2021-06-01' ~"Exclude",
    Sample_date < "2021-09-01" ~"Before",
    TRUE ~"During")) %>% 
  filter(., time_chunk != "Exclude") %>%
  group_by(time_chunk) %>% 
  mutate(., n_distinct(Sample_date)) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(prob_detection=sum(Detection_qPCR)/n_distinct(Sample_date)) %>% 
  mutate(., Method ="qPCR") -> kenai_summer_fall_qPCR
